reports.title: Bureau of National Statistics of the Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms of the Republic of Kazakhstan
reports.publisher: Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms of the Republic of Kazakhstan
reports.description: National statistical office of Kazakhstan, currently organized under the Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms; responsible for national accounts, CPI, and other official statistics. Confirmed live at stat.gov.kz.

reports.title: National Accounts of Kazakhstan (GDP and related aggregates)
reports.description: Official quarterly and annual national accounts and GDP estimates (production, income, expenditure approaches) published by the Bureau of National Statistics.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Kazakhstan
reports.description: Official monthly CPI and inflation statistics covering food, non-food, and services, published by the Bureau of National Statistics.

reports.title: National Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Statistics
reports.publisher: National Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Statistics
reports.description: Official national statistical office of Uzbekistan (site self-identifies as "National Committee", not "State Committee"); implementing statistical reforms under the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2020-25, including a stated goal of SDDS subscription.

reports.title: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic
reports.publisher: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic
reports.description: Official national statistical office of the Kyrgyz Republic; EAEU member-state statistical authority. Live site confirmed at stat.gov.kg (not stat.kg, which does not resolve for this agency).

reports.title: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan
reports.publisher: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan
reports.description: Official national statistical agency of Tajikistan; publishes population, inflation, GDP, and trade indicators and lists cooperation with the World Bank, UN, UNDP, ADB, UNICEF, and UNFPA.

reports.title: State Committee of Turkmenistan on Statistics (Turkmenstat)
reports.publisher: State Committee of Turkmenistan on Statistics
reports.description: Official national statistical body of Turkmenistan. Its own website (stat.gov.tm) is reachable but publishes essentially no distinct public methodology or series content; existence, mandate, and ongoing work toward an "updated version" of the System of National Accounts are corroborated by a UNDP Turkmenistan press release on a joint capacity-building project, since no specific SNA edition is named anywhere verifiable, no methodology edge is minted here.

reports.title: National Statistics Office of Mongolia (NSO)
reports.description: Official national statistical office of Mongolia (Ундэсний статистикийн хороо); canonical data portal at 1212.mn.

reports.title: National Accounts of Mongolia (GDP and related aggregates)
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP by production, expenditure, and income approaches) compiled by Mongolia's National Statistics Office, disseminated via its National Summary Data Page with SDMX downloads.

reports.title: National Statistics Office of Georgia (Geostat)
reports.description: Official national statistical office of Georgia, a legal entity of public law established by the Law of Georgia on Official Statistics (11 December 2009).

reports.title: National Accounts of Georgia (GDP and related aggregates)
reports.description: Official national accounts and GDP series compiled by Geostat.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Georgia
reports.description: Official monthly CPI compiled by Geostat, with basket items grouped by the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP) and weights from National Accounts and the Integrated Household Survey.

reports.title: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia (Armstat)
reports.publisher: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia
reports.description: Official national statistical office of Armenia; SDDS subscriber since 7 November 2003 (54th subscriber) and EAEU member-state statistical authority, cooperating with the Eurasian Economic Commission's Statistics Department.

reports.title: National Accounts of Armenia
reports.publisher: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia (Armstat)
reports.description: Official national accounts of Armenia; Armstat's own quality declaration states the methodology switched from SNA 1993 to SNA 2008 in 2014.

reports.title: Balance of Payments of Armenia
reports.description: Official quarterly balance of payments statistics of Armenia, compiled and published by the Central Bank of Armenia.

reports.title: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
reports.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
reports.description: Official national statistical office of Azerbaijan; hosts the country's e-GDDS National Summary Data Page covering GDP, CPI, government operations, balance of payments, and other indicators.

reports.title: Balance of Payments of Azerbaijan
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan
reports.description: Official quarterly balance of payments statistics of Azerbaijan, compiled by the Central Bank's Statistics Department according to BPM6.

reports.title: Protocol on the Procedure for the Formation and Dissemination of Official Statistical Information of the Eurasian Economic Union (Annex No. 4 to the EAEU Treaty)
reports.publisher: Eurasian Economic Union / Eurasian Economic Commission
reports.description: Annex 4 to the 2014 EAEU Treaty (Article 24), requiring member states' authorized statistical bodies to supply official statistical information to the Eurasian Economic Commission according to an agreed list of indicators, and empowering the Commission to approve methodology and pursue cross-country comparability of standards.

dependencies.basis: IMF's own SDDS annual observance report for Kazakhstan states the subscription date; confirmed by directly fetching the live PDF. Evidence: "Kazakhstan subscribed to the SDDS on March 24, 2003, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription."

IMF's own SDDS annual observance report for Mongolia states the subscription date; confirmed by directly fetching the live PDF. Evidence: "Mongolia subscribed to the SDDS on April 1, 2019, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription."

Armstat's own website states its SDDS subscription date and subscriber number directly. Evidence: "On November 7, 2003, the Republic of Armenia became the 54th subscriber to the International Monetary Fund's Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS)."

IMF's own press release confirms the Kyrgyz Republic's SDDS subscription date and subscriber number; confirmed by directly fetching the live page. Evidence: "On February 26, 2004 the Kyrgyz Republic became the 57th subscriber to the International Monetary Fund's Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS)"

Azerbaijan's State Statistical Committee hosts the country's e-GDDS National Summary Data Page itself, directly evidencing e-GDDS participation. Evidence: "Data linked from this page correspond to data described in the International Monetary Fund's DSBB."

Uzbekistan's own World Bank-published National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2020-25 states the country has joined the e-GDDS and lists IMF assistance toward SDDS as an ongoing objective. Evidence: "The Republic has joined the IMF's enhanced General Data Dissemination System and the functioning of the open data portal has been improved both in terms of the quality of information and its content."

Geostat's own national accounts metadata document names SNA 2008 as the methodological basis, confirmed by directly fetching the live PDF. Evidence: "Methodological basis of the National Accounts of Georgia is a standard methodology of the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA-2008) recommended by the United Nations, Eurostat, the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development, the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund."

Armstat's own quality declaration for national accounts/GNI states the 2014 methodological switch from SNA 1993 to SNA 2008, confirmed by directly fetching the live PDF. Evidence: "Since 2014 Statistical Committee has been made methodological changes in national accounts of Armenia introducing SNA 2008 instead of SNA 1993."

Kazakhstan's Bureau of National Statistics states directly, in its own current live metadata, that quarterly national accounts are based on SNA 2008 -- this independently found source supersedes an unverifiable Grok claim (see _dropped) that Kazakhstan still used the 1993 SNA, sourced to a JS-rendered IMF page whose content could not be confirmed and which is contradicted by this current statement. Evidence: "QNA is based on the requirements of the international standard 'System of National Accounts - 2008' and the 'Guide to Quarterly National Accounts' of the International Monetary Fund."

As an EAEU member-state authorized body, Kazakhstan's Bureau of National Statistics operates under Annex 4's obligation to supply official statistical information to the Commission; the Commission's own published text of Article 24/Annex 4 was independently located and fetched (Grok's originally cited adilet.zan.kz URL contains only the treaty body referencing the annex, not the annex text itself). Evidence: "Уполномоченные органы предоставляют Комиссии официальную статистическую информацию государств-членов согласно перечню статистических показателей" ("The authorized bodies shall provide the Commission with the official statistical information of the member states according to the list of statistical indicators.")

As an EAEU member-state authorized body, the Kyrgyz National Statistical Committee is subject to the same Annex 4 obligation to supply official statistical information to the Commission. Evidence: "Уполномоченные органы предоставляют Комиссии официальную статистическую информацию государств-членов согласно перечню статистических показателей" ("The authorized bodies shall provide the Commission with the official statistical information of the member states according to the list of statistical indicators.")

Armstat's own website states directly that it cooperates with the Eurasian Economic Commission's Statistics Department, which administers the Annex 4 protocol governing EAEU member states' statistical-information obligations. Evidence: "Armstat actively cooperates with the Interstate Statistical Committee of the Commonwealth of Independent States and Statistics Department of the Eurasian Economic Commission."

The Central Bank of Azerbaijan's own published Balance of Payments report names BPM6 as the classification standard used, confirmed by directly fetching the live PDF. Evidence: "Under the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual (sixth edition), the capital and financial account in the BOP structure is classified under the Assets/Liabilities principle."

_dropped.why: [Grok batch2] Grok cited a DSBB DQAF page (dsbb.imf.org/sdds/dqaf-base/country/KAZ/category/NAG00) as stating 'Analytical framework: 1993 SNA', but that page is a JS-rendered shell that returned no country content when fetched live -- the quote could not be independently confirmed. Kazakhstan's own current metadata (stat.gov.kz) states quarterly national accounts are 'based on the requirements of the international standard System of National Accounts - 2008', directly contradicting the SNA-1993 claim. Also note: sna-1993 is not even a live id in this corpus (only sna-2008 and sna-2025 exist), so this edge could never have been minted as proposed regardless.

[Grok batch1] Fetched the live Geostat CPI Methodology page directly. It does say the basket is 'grouped according to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP)' and separately mentions 'the European version ... ECOICOP' for the HICP, but neither mention carries a year or edition. Per the edition-matching rule, a generic COICOP mention with no stated edition is not enough to pick un-coicop-2018 over un-coicop-hbs-1999.

[Grok batch3] Fetched the live stat.gov.kz 'CPI questions and answers' PDF directly. It states items are grouped 'according to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP), developed by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development' with no year/edition given anywhere in the document. Same edition-ambiguity issue as the Georgia CPI edge; not enough to pick a specific COICOP node.

[Grok batch2] Grok's cited DSBB DQAF page for Mongolia (dsbb.imf.org/sdds/dqaf-base/country/MNG/category/NAG00) is a JS-rendered shell; live fetch returned no country-specific content, so the quoted sentence could not be confirmed. Searched Mongolia's NSO/NSDP site and a 2017 IMF technical-assistance report on Mongolia's national accounts mission; the TA report only says the NSO is 'continuing to implement the current international standard' without naming an edition. No accessible primary source names a specific SNA edition for Mongolia.

_dropped.edge: kz-bns / kg-nsc / am-armstat -> eaeu-stat-methodology-2023 (proposed node, not minted)
_dropped.why: [Grok batch2] Could not confirm the existence, exact number, date, or title of 'EEC Board Decision No. 175 of 19 December 2023 approving a Methodology of Forming Official Statistical Information of the EAEU' on any primary EEC/government source. Grok's only citation was cis-legislation.com, a third-party legal-document aggregator, which is explicitly disallowed as a citation, and it returned a server error on live fetch anyway. Independent searching for the decision number/date/title on eec.eaeunion.org and adilet.zan.kz instead surfaced a different, similarly-dated decision (Decision No. 179, 27 December 2023, 'On the provision of official statistical information to the EEC by member states' authorized bodies'), suggesting Grok's decision number and/or subject may be inaccurate. Dropping the node and all three dependent edges (kz-bns, kg-nsc, am-armstat -> eaeu-stat-methodology-2023) rather than minting on an unverifiable citation.

[Grok batch3] Grok's cited DSBB SDDS summary-methodology page for Armenia BOP is a JS-rendered shell; live fetch returned no country content. Checked the Central Bank of Armenia's own balance-of-payments and external-sector statistics pages directly (cba.am) -- they exist and list BOP data categories but the fetched page content contains no methodology text naming BPM6 (unlike Azerbaijan's central bank, which does state this explicitly in a published report). The am-bop report node itself is still minted since its existence as a recurring CBA publication is independently confirmed; only the specific BPM6 methodology edge is dropped for lack of a verifiable live quote.

[Grok batch1] Grok's cited DSBB e-GDDS summary page for Tajikistan is a JS-rendered shell with no country content on live fetch. An IMF press release titled 'Tajikistan Implements the International Monetary Fund's Enhanced General Data Dissemination System' (March 2020, pr20/96) was located by search, corroborating the underlying fact, but its body text is behind IMF's JS-rendered article template and could not be fetched to obtain a verbatim quote; Tajikistan's own NSDP subdomain (nsdp.stat.tj) and the agency's homepage (stat.tj) were also checked directly -- the homepage carries no IMF/e-GDDS mention and the NSDP subdomain could not be reached due to a certificate/robots error. Real, but currently unreadable through available tools; a lead for a future pass, not a mint.
